description: This file defines partial logging methods for the ActivationRebalancerWorker class in the Orleans runtime, specifically for tracing and warning messages related to rebalancing activations across silos. It contains method signatures decorated with LoggerMessage attributes for structured logging.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: A partial class responsible for managing activation rebalancing in Orleans runtime, with predefined logging methods for tracing its operations.

methods.name: LogScheduledToStart
methods.description: Logs that the activation rebalancer has been scheduled to start after a specified due time.

methods.name: LogSessionStarted
methods.description: Logs that a new rebalancing session has started.

methods.name: LogSessionStopped
methods.description: Logs that the current rebalancing session has stopped.

methods.name: LogSuspended
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has been suspended indefinitely.

methods.name: LogSuspendedFor
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has been suspended for a specified duration.

methods.name: LogNotEnoughSilos
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing cannot continue due to insufficient silos.

methods.name: LogNotEnoughStatistics
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing cannot continue due to insufficient statistics information.

methods.name: LogInvalidSiloMemory
methods.description: Logs invalid memory reporting by silos, possibly indicating missing environment statistics provider.

methods.name: LogMaxStagnantCyclesReached
methods.description: Logs that the rebalancing session has stopped after reaching the maximum allowed stagnant cycles.

methods.name: LogMaxEntropyDeviationReached
methods.description: Logs that the entropy deviation has reached a threshold, stopping rebalancing.

methods.name: LogInsufficientEntropyQuantum
methods.description: Logs that the entropy change is too small to consider an improvement.

methods.name: LogStagnantCyclesReset
methods.description: Logs that stagnant cycle count has been reset.

methods.name: LogFailedSessionsReset
methods.description: Logs that failed session count has been reset.

methods.name: LogSiloMigrations
methods.description: Logs details about activation migrations between silos during rebalancing.

methods.name: LogCycleOutcome
methods.description: Logs the outcome of a rebalancing cycle, including entropy and cycle counts.
